questions.search_text:
When a positive integer \(N\) is fed into a machine, the output is a number calculated according to the rule shown below.



For example, starting with an input of \(N=7,\) the machine will output \(3 \cdot 7 + 1 = 22.\) Then if the output is repeatedly inserted into the machine five more times, the final output is \(26.\) \[ \begin{aligned} &7 \to 22 \to 11 \to 34 \\ &\to 17 \to 52 \to 26 \end{aligned} \] When the same \(6\)-step process is applied to a different starting value of \(N,\) the final output is \(1.\) What is the sum of all such integers \(N?\) \[ \begin{aligned} &N \to \underline{\phantom{00}} \to \underline{\phantom{00}} \to \underline{\phantom{00}}\\ &\to \underline{\phantom{00}} \to \underline{\phantom{00}} \to 1 \end{aligned} \]
